components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main pharmacy action button for checkout, confirmation, retry, and form submission.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: #0F766E; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 180ms ease-out, opacity 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.92; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(15,118,110,0.3); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Standard form field for auth, address, profile, and checkout data entry.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font-family: Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { color: #0F2F2B; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-input { height: 56px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1.5px solid #D1D5DB; border-radius: 14px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #0F2F2B; font-family: Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; } .ds-input:focus { border-width: 2px; border-color: #0F766E; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6B7280; }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: Compact shelf item with image shell, two-line name, price, and add-to-cart control.
components.css: .ds-product-card { width: 160px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; border-radius: 20px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #0F2F2B; font-family: Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; display: grid; gap: 8px; transition: transform 180ms ease-out, opacity 180ms ease-out; } .ds-product-card:hover { opacity: 0.95; transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-product-image { height: 120px; border-radius: 12px; background: #FFF7ED; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 34px; } .ds-product-card h3 { margin: 0; min-height: 36px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 18px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-product-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; } .ds-product-row span { color: #4B5563; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-product-row button { width: 36px; height: 36px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #0F766E; color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Semantic order/payment status chip with soft background and explicit text.
components.css: .ds-status-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 12px; background: #E5F5F2; color: #0F766E; font-family: Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; }

components.name: Bottom Action Bar
components.description: Safe-area footer for checkout and forms, keeping the primary action reachable.
components.css: .ds-bottom-action { padding: 8px 16px 16px; border-top: 1px solid #E5E7EB; background: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: 0px -6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); } .ds-bottom-action .ds-btn-primary { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #0F766E; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: MD3 Tab Pill
components.description: Bottom navigation active indicator behind icons.
components.css: .ds-tab { width: 80px; height: 64px; display: grid; place-items: center; gap: 3px; color: #0F766E; font-family: Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-tab-pill { width: 64px; height: 32px; border-radius: 16px; background: rgba(15,118,110,0.12); display: grid; place-items: center; transition: opacity 200ms ease-out, transform 250ms ease-out; }

narrative.overview: This system should feel like a familiar pharmacy counter translated to a phone: orderly shelves, readable labels, a calm attendant nearby, and no pressure to rush a health decision. PRODUCT.md defines the posture as a trusted neighborhood pharmacy on the phone, so the interface must prioritize confidence, recovery paths, and clear Indonesian copy before promotional energy.
keyCharacteristics: Mobile-first, product-register UI for shopping, checkout, order tracking, profile, and support workflows.
Teal is the primary trust signal; semantic colors are functional and restrained.
Poppins carries both headings and body copy for a friendly, readable, contemporary voice.
Surfaces are rounded, bordered, and softly layered rather than glassy or dramatic.
Every purchase-critical screen needs clear recovery paths: retry, resume payment, edit address, track shipment, or contact support.

rules.name: The Teal Earns Trust Rule
rules.body: Primary teal is for decisive, helpful actions and selected state, not decorative striping or arbitrary emphasis.

rules.name: The Soft Semantic Rule
rules.body: Success, warning, danger, and info colors must appear with their soft backgrounds in badges or notices whenever possible. Never rely on color alone for order or payment status.

rules.name: The No Flash-Sale Rule
rules.body: Promotions may guide discovery, but the color system must never create marketplace urgency that overpowers medication safety, price clarity, delivery expectations, or support.

rules.name: The Label-First Rule
rules.body: Medicine names, prices, address details, and payment status must stay legible before the layout tries to be expressive.

rules.name: The Weight Is the Accent Rule
rules.body: Use font weight and spacing for emphasis before adding another color. This protects the restrained pharmacy tone.

rules.name: The Surface Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Start with `$surface`, `$surfaceSubtle`, borders, and spacing. Add shadow only when the user needs to understand persistence, action priority, or modal interruption.

rules.name: The No Decorative Glass Rule
rules.body: Blur and glassmorphism are not part of this system. Use solid surfaces and readable contrast.

dos: Do use `$primary` Counter Teal for primary actions, selected state, focused fields, and cart/payment progress.
Do keep all tappable controls at 48px minimum unless the component is a clearly secondary nested control with an accessible parent.
Do keep product names readable at two lines, prices visible, and checkout totals bold enough to scan.
Do use Poppins 600-800 for important labels, totals, and headings; use muted color plus smaller size for helper copy.
Do use `$surface`, `$surfaceSubtle`, `$surfaceBorder`, and soft elevation before adding new decorative effects.
Do pair semantic color with explicit words: unpaid, packed, shipped, completed, failed, retry, edit, confirm.
Do use `FormInput` as the preferred general form pattern and keep auth-specific inputs visually aligned with it.
Do choose between `BottomActionBar` and `StickyBottomBar` intentionally, based on whether a total summary is part of the action.
donts: Don't create discount-marketplace patterns where flash-sale energy, dense cards, urgency tactics, or cluttered promotions overpower medicine safety and trust.
Don't use colored side-stripe borders as a card accent. Existing left-accent hero usage is technical debt to avoid, not a pattern to expand.
Don't introduce gradient text, decorative glassmorphism, or nested card grids.
Don't hide delivery fees, stock limitations, prescription constraints, payment status, or support paths behind decorative hierarchy.
Don't rely on color alone for order, payment, stock, notification, or validation state.
Don't add a third bottom action/footer pattern unless both existing bars fail a concrete checkout or form need.
Don't create new Tamagui theme tokens without updating `themes.ts`, `constants/ui.ts` fallbacks, and non-Tamagui theme bridges.
Don't use raw black or raw white for new ad hoc styles. Use existing tokens and tinted surfaces so future dark/light modes stay coherent.
